text:
olivia-partner: Quick sync — we hit one blocker on the Snowlake ingest schema mismatch in staging. Small sample payloads are failing vectorization.
raj-engineering: Can you paste the failing row? I pushed a tiny fix last night but might not have covered the nested metadata.
olivia-partner: here's one failing row (sanitized):
```
{ "doc_id": "abc-123", "text": "Customer support logs...", "embedding_meta": { "source": "s3", "region": "eu-west-1" }}
```
raj-engineering: looks like `embedding_meta` needs to flatten to top-level key for the qdrant connector. I'll add a preprocessor to map `embedding_meta.*` -> `meta_*`.
tess-sre: heads up — staging cluster is at 75% mem due to a previous batch-run. If we add preprocessor, please keep CPU-bound work off the critical path. Queue as async transform.
marco-pm: For launch gate, we need: dataplane e2e (ingest->vectorstore->query), marketplace manifest + logo, SI engineer handoff doc. Who owns marketplace manifest?
kevin-se: I'll take marketplace metadata + sample queries. Need copy for listing and required tags: `redwood_compat:true`, `connector_type:vector-ingest`, `hw_cert:none`.
olivia-partner: Also need security checklist from Snowflake side re: OAuth vs key pair auth. Snow team prefers OAuth for marketplace flows.
raj-engineering: I'll implement optional OAuth in connector config. Will toggle via `auth.mode = oauth|key`.
kevin-se: Sample config snippet for customers:
```
connector:
  name: redwood-sf-vector
  auth:
    mode: oauth
    client_id: <REDACTED>
    scopes: ["session:ingest","data:read"]
```
marco-pm: ETA for preprocessor + OAuth toggle?
raj-engineering: preprocessor by EOD tomorrow, oauth toggle by end of week. Tess, any constraints for deploying the toggle?
tess-sre: Need canary policy: 10% traffic -> 30 mins -> rollback on >5% error rise. Deploy-bot will create the canary rollout.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary rollout for branch `feat/sf-auth` to staging at 2024-09-18T14:00Z. Monitor `ingest.error_rate` and `latency.p95`.
olivia-partner: Great. One more ask: for SI handoff, can we prepare a CSV with sample datasets, expected embeddings, and acceptance criteria? (e.g., recall@10 > 0.7 on test set)
kevin-se: Yes — I'll generate sample queries + golden responses and add a small notebook demonstrating ingest -> query.
marco-pm: I'll own the launch gate doc and checklist. Next sync Fri 10am PT. Please add blockers to this thread before then.
olivia-partner: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
raj-engineering: merging draft PR now.
kevin-se: uploading marketplace assets to /shared/marketplace_assets/sf-vector-v1.zip
olivia-partner: noted — will run the SI kickoff once PR is green.
